claims.claim_text: The indexed Technician Fourth Grade Otis L. Ausen is strongly matched to the Otis Ausen listed with the OSS Norwegian Operational Group.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The historical personnel roster lists Otis Ausen at the same uncommon name and enlisted grade in OSS Norwegian operations.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence: the exact distinctive surname and given name, matching middle initial, matching Technician Fourth Grade, and explicit OSS Norwegian Operational Group context align with the visually verified Box 26 row.
claims.temporal_assessment: The roster establishes wartime OSS assignment context, not a pre-OSS employer or the date of entry into OSS.
claims.match_notes: The matching uncommon name, initial, rank, and OSS context exceed a name-only match. Direct personnel-file or private-identifier confirmation remains necessary.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Corporal James W. Austin is confirmed as the same Army enlistee represented in the official merged enlistment file.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official enlistment record matches the OSS index's private identifier and exact indexed name.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed: the unique private Army identifier is an exact cross-source match, and the official record prints the exact full indexed name.
claims.temporal_assessment: The enlistment record predates OSS service and supplies entry-time context; it does not establish the date he joined OSS.
claims.match_notes: The full identifier is deliberately omitted from public evidence and downloads.

claims.claim_text: At Army entry, James W. Austin was recorded as a student; the institution is not identified.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The matched enlistment record contains civilian occupation code 992, which NARA's official code list defines as students.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The exact private identifier and exact name confirm that the enlistment record belongs to the indexed James W. Austin.
claims.temporal_assessment: Documented at Army entrance on 17 September 1942. The record does not show whether student status was the immediate predecessor to OSS service.
claims.match_notes: Student status is not an employer. No university or school is named, so none is inferred.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Private First Class Kenneth P. Austin is confirmed as the same Army enlistee represented in the official merged enlistment file, which prints middle initial R.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official enlistment record exactly matches the private identifier but differs from the OSS index in the middle initial.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by the unique exact private Army identifier. The P/R initial discrepancy is preserved and is consistent with NARA's documented cautions about scanning and keypunch errors.
claims.temporal_assessment: The enlistment record supplies pre-OSS entry-time context but not an OSS recruitment date.
claims.match_notes: Neither initial is silently corrected. Box 26 and the underlying enlistment card should be examined to resolve the discrepancy.

claims.claim_text: At Army entry, the enlistee matched to Kenneth P. Austin was recorded as a student; the institution is not identified.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The matched enlistment record contains civilian occupation code 992, which NARA's official code list defines as students.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The exact private identifier confirms the identity despite the P/R middle-initial discrepancy between official sources.
claims.temporal_assessment: Documented at Army entrance on 14 July 1943. It is not shown to be the immediate predecessor to OSS service.
claims.match_notes: Student status is not an employer. No university or school is named, so none is inferred.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Corporal Vernon L. Austreng is confirmed as the North Dakota Army veteran and OSS Norwegian Operational Group member documented in the reviewed sources.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official state register matches the exact private identifier and indexed name; the OSS roster independently matches his name, initial, grade, and Norwegian assignment.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by an exact unique private identifier across the OSS index, official Army file, and official state register, with independent OSS roster corroboration.
claims.temporal_assessment: The enlistment and state records establish Army entry in December 1942; the OSS roster establishes later Norwegian operations but not the precise OSS entry date.
claims.match_notes: The Army merged file prints middle initial N and an enlistment day that differs from the state register. Both discrepancies remain visible pending card and personnel-file review.

claims.claim_text: At Army entry, Vernon L. Austreng was recorded as a general-farm hand; no employing farm is identified.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The matched enlistment record contains civilian occupation code 316, which NARA's official code list defines as farm hands on general farms.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The exact private identifier across three official records confirms the identity despite the merged file's middle-initial discrepancy.
claims.temporal_assessment: Documented at Army entrance in December 1942. The precise day conflicts across official sources, and the role is not proven to be the immediate predecessor to OSS.
claims.match_notes: An occupation without a named employing organization is not converted into an employer or self-employment claim.
